name: @defprod/scripts
description: CLI utilities for DefProd — sync test status, manage products, and automate your definition-driven workflow

scripts.prepack: v=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && sed -i "s/^VERSION=\"[^\"]*\" # baked at pack time$/VERSION=\"$v\" # baked at pack time/" scripts/sync-story-test-status.sh && grep -q "^VERSION=\"$v\" # baked at pack time$" scripts/sync-story-test-status.sh || { echo "prepack: could not bake VERSION into scripts/sync-story-test-status.sh" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.postpack: sed -i "s/^VERSION=\"[^\"]*\" # baked at pack time$/VERSION=\"dev\" # baked at pack time/" scripts/sync-story-test-status.sh
